inspiration: Note hits spawn a pooled splash sprite: one sprite is reused and given one of several animation variants by direction, with a small frame-rate variance so repeat hits do not look identical (source/funkin/play/notes/NoteSplash.hx: splashFramerate = 24, splashFramerateVariance).

The pre-song countdown is a three-step sequence whose graphic and sound swap by note style, for example a pixel variant for one week (source/funkin/play/Countdown.hx, soundSuffix and the Week 6 comment).

The results screen layers a sticker-style transition, bitmap-font score text, gradient backgrounds and a scrolling backdrop (source/funkin/play/ResultState.hx imports: StickerSubState, FlxBitmapFont, FlxGradient, FlxBackdrop).

Credits are data: roles with an optional header, a body of lines and an option to append backers automatically (source/funkin/ui/credits/CreditsData.hx). A data-driven credit roll updates without code edits.

Character definitions are data-driven (source/funkin/data/character/CharacterData.hx), so a new character is a data entry, not a code change. The data files themselves are upstream and not in the box.
The style can be switched per note style (source/funkin/play/notes/notestyle/ is the hook; the countdown reads the style's suffix). Build a per-level skin as a style, not a fork.

briefs.label: Pooled hit burst
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A single reused sprite with direction variants and a frame-rate jitter gives many hit bursts for little memory.
briefs.keep: Pooled sprite reuse; direction-based variant pick; small frame-rate jitter
briefs.change: A shard or ring burst instead of a sprite burst; a different palette; no frame-accurate match to the beat

briefs.label: Ready-set cue
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A three-step pre-start cue sets the beat before the song begins.
briefs.keep: Three steps before start; per-style swap of graphic and sound
briefs.change: A slam or rotating card instead of three numbers; one-word cue; a different sound family

briefs.label: Sticker results transition
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A sticker-sheet style transition makes the results screen feel like a reward.
briefs.keep: Stamp-like transition into results; bitmap score font; scrolling backdrop
briefs.change: Paper-cut or torn-edge transition instead of stickers; a different score font; a vertical backdrop

briefs.label: Backer roll credits
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A credit roll built from role blocks with an auto-appended backers list keeps credits current with no code edits.
briefs.keep: Role blocks with headers; backers appended from data; roll-up text
briefs.change: Scroll sideways or as a film strip; a different block order; no header for the backers block
